jobs.title: Hospital Security Lead – Patrol, Respond, Protect
jobs.description:
Montefiore Nyack Hospital is seeking a Security Officer to secure the premises with minimal supervision. You will patrol the property, monitor surveillance, inspect buildings and access points, and report irregularities to prevent losses.

The role requires 1–3 years in hospital security, CPR/First Aid, and a willingness to work across departments while maintaining professional conduct. Equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Retail Security Officer: Growth, Benefits & Flexible Shifts
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer Site Protection in Joliet, IL to monitor a dynamic retail location, deter incidents, and provide exceptional customer service while maintaining a secure, welcoming environment.

You will conduct patrols, respond calmly to incidents, and follow site-specific policies as part of a caring team that values integrity and service. This is a full-time position with daytime and evening shifts.

jobs.title: Healthcare Security Officer – Day Shift
jobs.description:
Saint Joseph Medical Center - Joliet in Joliet, IL seeks a full-time Security Officer to perform security services, electronic surveillance, and routine rounds. The role coordinates responses to incidents, enforces policy, and collaborates with the Environment of Care committee to maintain a safe work environment for staff and patients.

The position requires a high school diploma or equivalent and may involve driving as needed for company business. A state driver’s license is preferred at hire.

jobs.title: Casino Security Officer: Guest Safety and Dispatch
jobs.description:
PENN Entertainment is seeking a Security Officer to monitor staff and guests, ensuring compliance with policies and safety rules across the Joliet facility. You will maintain security of operations, answer calls professionally, and log events in the system while supporting a positive guest experience.

The role requires reading and writing English, basic multitasking, and the ability to obtain and maintain an IL Gaming Board license along with a valid driver’s license.

jobs.title: Unarmed Security Officer: Growth, Benefits & Quick Pay
jobs.description:
Metro One Loss Prevention Services Group in Joliet, IL is hiring an Unarmed Security Officer. Deliver exceptional customer service to clients and visitors, monitor CCTV surveillance, and complete accurate daily activity reports while observing, surveying, and reporting on activities at your post.

Requirements include being at least 18, a high school diploma or GED, authorization to work in the United States, ability to pass a drug test and background screening, and reliable transportation.
